subject: Demo + Pricing Discussion — Finex / Redwood (pricing & budget follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.com>, Priya Sen <priya.sen@finex.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo + Pricing Discussion — Finex / Redwood (recap & next steps)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can align on pricing and budget:

Key notes from the demo:
- Primary use case: in-product assistant for customer support (conversational + relevant docs).
- Expected steady-state volume: ~20–30M inference tokens/month for initial POC, ramping to ~100M/mo in 6–9 months if CX metrics look good.
- Embeddings usage for semantic search: ~5–10M tokens/month.
- Latency target: 200–400ms 95th for chat flows; retention: 30 days KV cache.
- Compliance: SOC 2 required; need to confirm any other legal terms.

Mutual action plan (proposal):
1) We (Redwood) share a preliminary pricing estimate + example unit economics for 1M and 10M token buckets (attached).
2) Finex to confirm the budget owner / economic buyer and any hard budget ranges for the POC.
3) Finex to share procurement timeline and required docs (procurement contact + SOW reviewers).
4) Schedule a short follow-up (30 min) to review the final quote and next steps — propose Thu 5/14 or Fri 5/15.

Ask for you now: can you confirm who will sign off on price (economic buyer) and what monthly budget range you expect for the initial POC (ballpark is fine)? That helps me tailor the pricing and any commitment discounts.

Attaching a preliminary pricing estimate (Excel) with unit economics and commit-tier examples.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachment: 20260512-Redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sen <priya.sen@finex.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo + Pricing Discussion — Finex / Redwood (recap & next steps)

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A few follow-ups from our side: 

1) Unit economics: can you please include a clear line for $/1M inference tokens (and note how you count tokens — e.g., input+output)? Also separate line for embeddings. For our internal comparison we look at $/1M tokens as the main number.

2) Budget: for the POC we have a constrained range. Our initial internal target is $15k–$25k/month. That would need to cover expected traffic for the POC (roughly 20–30M tokens/mo). If your per-1M rates are outside that range, please also include a committed usage option (3mo or 12mo) with discounts.

3) Economic buyer: Priya is leading product and will be the business sponsor, but finance sign-off will come from Rajesh Mehta (CFO). I can loop Rajesh in once we have a final quote and procurement path.

4) Timeline: procurement is fairly standard — I attached our procurement timeline. We aim to complete POC contracting within 2–3 weeks if the numbers align.

Can you send a tightened quote (1M, 10M, and committed monthly price) and we’ll try to get Rajesh to review once we have those lines. Also include any SLA/uptime and data handling notes (SOC 2).

Alex
Head of Engineering — Product Integrations
Finex Corp
alex.turner@finex.com | (212) 555-0890

Attachment: finex_procurement_timeline.pdf

Marissa —

Suggested pricing to be competitive vs. public cloud + managed infra, while protecting unit economics for Redwood: 
- List price (no commit): $900 per 1M inference tokens (input+output), embeddings $120 per 1M tokens.
- POC: for 3-month POC we can offer $650 per 1M (early-adopter POC price) if they commit to a 3-month min spend of $15k/mo.
- 12-month commit pricing: $450 per 1M with a 12-month committed ARR (volume to be defined) — includes 10% extra discount if they prepay quarterly.
- Example math: at 20M tokens/mo, list price = $18,000/mo; POC price = $13,000/mo; 12-mo commit = $9,000/mo.

Recommend we present both: (A) a POC option that fits their $15k–$25k/mo window (3mo commit @ $650/1M), and (B) an expansion path showing 12-mo commit economics. Also include the SOC 2 / SLA bullets and note that dedicated capacity is available if they need stronger latency guarantees (separate pricing).

I can draft the 1‑pager. Economic buyer = Rajesh (confirm by Alex) — once we have confirmed we should route commercial terms to finance and procurement.

-Nikhil
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

- Confirmed: economic buyer is Rajesh Mehta (CFO). Please include him on the next commercial email thread.
- Budget: initial POC target is $15k–$25k/month. The POC at $650/1M would be in-range depending on actual token usage; please include a conservative 30M token/mo example.
- Request: please send explicit lines for:
   * 1M token price (list and POC)
   * 10M token bucket price (list and POC)
   * Embeddings per-1M price
   * Any minimum monthly commit and cancellation terms

Next steps: please send a short pricing summary + simple SOW and we will loop Rajesh and procurement (procurement timeline attached previously). We aim to have finance review within 1 week once we have concrete numbers.

Looping Priya and copying Rajesh on the next email will help speed review.

Thanks,
Alex
